---
title: "Recommended reading"
---

This page is intentionally a scaffold. Add the EU-NESA-recommended sources and current methodological references agreed with the Working Group before final release.

Suggested categories:

- effect-size choice and interpretation;
- random-effects meta-analysis and heterogeneity;
- dependent effect sizes and multilevel models;
- meta-regression;
- reporting/publication bias;
- transparent and reproducible reporting.
